depth_scaling_analysis.phenomenon: Depth Variance & Semantic Over-Abstraction at L=120
depth_scaling_analysis.observation: At depth 120, repeated self-attention causes deep representations to drift toward high-level semantic attractors, overriding strict lexical prompt constraints (e.g., renaming requested functions to generic descriptive names or expanding recursive arithmetic).
depth_scaling_analysis.optimal_depth_regime: K66 (L=66) represents the empirical Pareto-optimal depth for layer cloning with Campo v4 without requiring end-to-end retraining.
